help.title: Help
help.saving.title: How saving works
help.saving.body: Every answer is saved on your phone as you type. When you tap “Save form”, the form waits in line to be sent. You never need network to save.
help.offline.title: What happens when there is no network?
help.offline.body: Keep working. Saved forms wait safely on the phone, locked with your password. When network comes back, FieldSync sends them by itself — on most Android phones even if the app is closed.
help.colours.title: What the labels mean
help.colours.body: Waiting: saved, not sent yet. Sending: going to the server now. Will retry: the network failed, FieldSync will try again by itself. Sent: the server has it. Needs fixing or Changed on server: open the form and follow the steps.
help.problems.title: If a form needs attention
help.problems.body: “Needs fixing” means the server could not accept an answer: open it, correct it, send again. “Changed on server” means your supervisor changed it: choose which version to keep.
help.lost.title: If your phone is lost or stolen
help.lost.body: Tell your supervisor at once. They will remove the phone from FieldSync. Your saved forms are encrypted, so nobody can read them without your password.
help.shared.title: Sharing a phone
help.shared.body: Each person signs in with their own account, and each account’s forms are locked separately. Use “Switch user” in Settings. Never share passwords.
help.support: When something goes wrong, FieldSync shows a support code like FS-1A2B3C. Read it to your supervisor.
help.install.title: Install FieldSync
help.install.body: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. Installed, FieldSync opens like an app and the phone protects its saved forms.
